notes: TEMPLATE for the mainnet approval package. Every value starting with REPLACE_ME must be filled in; the runner refuses the template as is.
Pinned by read-only mainnet RPC on 2026-11-03: chain_id/genesis_hash (status); code hashes at blocks 222940261-222940273 (view_account); versions from contract_source_metadata.

Budget caps follow the build plan's lead-run proposal: owner inventory <= $10 equivalent, one fill <= $2, filler inventory <= $2 equivalent, fees <= 0.1 NEAR. wNEAR unit caps assume NEAR ~= $3.3: recompute from the price on the approval day.
Deployment and storage (<= 5 NEAR allocation) and all funding are done separately by the owner; this runner never funds, deposits or deploys.
The worst-case fee of the steps below at gas price 1e8 yocto is (sum of gas_tgas + 5 per step) x 1e12 x 1e8 = 0.0895 NEAR; preflight refuses if the live gas price makes it exceed max_fee_yocto.

Run: MANDATE_LIVE=1 MANDATE_LIVE_MANIFEST=<this file> MANDATE_LIVE_CONFIRM=<sha256 of this file> make live. Resume after a stop: add MANDATE_LIVE_RESUME=1 (reconciles the ledger in out/live/<sha256>/ first).

accounts.agent: REPLACE_ME: agent account (only key: function-call propose_order)

code_hashes.mandate: REPLACE_ME: base58 sha256 of the reviewed mandate WASM (equals view_account code_hash after deployment)

mandate_full_access: REPLACE_ME: each full-access key the approved upgrade-key policy allows on the mandate account; use [] for a locked account

agent.public_key: REPLACE_ME: ed25519 public key of the agent's function-call key

owner.public_key: REPLACE_ME: ed25519 public key of the owner's full-access key used here

filler.public_key: REPLACE_ME: ed25519 public key of the filler's full-access key
filler.intents_public_key: REPLACE_ME: ed25519 key the filler registered on intents.near (add_public_key)

credentials.owner: REPLACE_ME: absolute path to the owner credential JSON (chmod 600, outside the repo)
credentials.agent: REPLACE_ME: absolute path to the agent credential JSON
credentials.filler: REPLACE_ME: absolute path to the filler account credential JSON
credentials.filler_intents: REPLACE_ME: absolute path to the filler Intents signing key JSON

expected_nonces.owner: REPLACE_ME: owner key nonce read at approval time
expected_nonces.agent: REPLACE_ME: agent key nonce read at approval time
expected_nonces.filler: REPLACE_ME: filler key nonce read at approval time
